description: This Java test class 'OpenmrsTestsTest' is designed to enforce project conventions and testing standards within the OpenMRS codebase. It includes tests that verify naming conventions, presence of annotations, and migration status to JUnit 5, among other quality assurance checks.

classes.name: OpenmrsTestsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that enforces naming conventions, annotation presence, class naming, migration status, and class directory structure within the OpenMRS project to maintain code quality and consistency.

methods.name: shouldHaveAtLeastOneTest
methods.description: Ensures there is more than one test class present in the project.

methods.name: shouldStartWithShould
methods.description: Verifies all test methods in the test classes start with 'should' or contain '_should'.

methods.name: shouldHaveTestAnnotationWhenStartingWithShould
methods.description: Checks that methods starting with 'should' or containing '_should' have an @Test annotation.

methods.name: shouldHaveClassNameEndWithTestIfContainsMethodTestAnnotations
methods.description: Ensures classes with @Test methods end with 'Test' unless they're annotated to be ignored or disabled.

methods.name: shouldNotAllowAnyNewJUnit4TestsSinceWeMigratedToJUnit5
methods.description: Verifies no new JUnit 4 tests are added in the codebase; only specific allowed classes are permitted to have JUnit 4 tests for migration reasons.

methods.name: getTestClasses
methods.description: Retrieves all test classes ending with 'Test', 'IT', or 'PT'.

methods.name: getClasses
methods.description: Loads classes matching a given filename regex from the classpath within the 'org.openmrs' package.

methods.name: getClassesInDirectory
methods.description: Recursively collects classes from a directory that match a filename pattern.
